system.description: Declared before the Dominate challenge, spend a Willpower Trait and make a standard Dominate test against the most resistant member of a group while maintaining eye contact only with that initial subject. Success extends the effect to additional targets you choose, up to half your permanent Willpower Traits (round up); if the initial target resists, none of the group can be affected.
system.duration: As per the Dominate power used
